system.flavor:
Slow a thief in a crowded street so a friend catches up, bring a bolting horse down to a walk, hold a runner at a crossing, or make a sprinting courier stumble with thorns at their ankles. One person caught in the Court's briar.

Not enough to hold anyone fast, stop a cart, or slow a crowd.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Arcane Damage and make it Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn; it may end the Slow by burning 1 die on its turn.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress its ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Fey
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Fey Full Manifestation (FM-2F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
